content: Additional considerations must be taken into account when diagnosing diabetes, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). Variations in glucose levels throughout the day, known as diurnal variation, can complicate the accuracy of glucose testing. Furthermore, the requirement for fasting prior to testing may introduce additional challenges. External factors, including recent physical activity, psychological stress, or the presence of an illness, can significantly influence glucose levels, potentially leading to misleading test results.
